query_text: Create a dumbbell chart for the top 12 companies with the largest difference between `IPO probability rank` and `Commercial Maturity rank`, where one end of each dumbbell is the IPO-probability rank and the other is the Commercial-Maturity rank, limited to companies with numeric maturity scores and sorted by absolute rank gap.
sort_rule: descending by absolute gap between IPO-probability rank and Commercial-Maturity rank
selection_rule: top 12 companies with numeric Commercial Maturity

plot_config.title: IPO rank vs Commercial Maturity rank

reasoning_summary: Filtered to companies with numeric Commercial Maturity.
Ranked companies by IPO probability and by Commercial Maturity.
Computed absolute rank gaps and selected the 12 largest divergences.
Plotted the two rank positions for each selected company.
open_issues: Commercial Maturity is a low-cardinality 1-5 scale, so ties are resolved with the deterministic min-rank convention.
